_doc: Yên Quang Các lineage (rules-proposals R5). Leans Wood, Earth unchanged; the seat moved in 1187 from the steppe (537, Wood 13 %) to Dã Tang Lâm, the wild mulberry wood (423, Wood 39 %, Earth 21 %). Outer gate: dusk-gathering-primer (Yellow, Wood or Earth). Inner gate and above: verdant-cycle-scripture (existing, Profound, Wood). Secret arts: evening-haze-furnace (inner gate), gathered-haze-canon (elders; the founder's). Unpriced.

secret.note: the founder Vi Ngưng Yên's; Diêm Tử Tô holds it and teaches it to no one since 1150

lineage.tree_route_note: The Lingzhi Ring idea (Lingzhi Cap, Fairy Ring, Lingzhi Ring): pill effect and lifespan, the furnace lit at dusk.

techniques.name: Dusk Gathering Primer (Vãn Thái Quyết)
techniques.concept: The picker's method. In the hour of the evening glow a plant holds the day's warmth and the night's stillness at once, and the picker who breathes with it takes both. The novice learns to kneel in the steppe grass at sunset and draw Wood from the herb and Earth from the soil it grew in, one breath for each, and to take one plant in three. In a fight the primer is gentle: it mends a little, slows a little, and lasts.

arts.concept: A light Wood strike; every third one on the same foe also heals the holder for a share of the damage dealt.

techniques.lore: The founder Vi Ngưng Yên taught it on the steppe below Lạc Hà's seat from 1065 (V107). It is still taught on the Dusk Field at the old seat, where the outer gate walks every evening.

techniques.name: Evening Haze Furnace Art (Yên Quang Lô Pháp)
techniques.concept: The furnace is lit at dusk and banked at dawn, and the smoke that rises off it in the evening is the pavilion's name: the hazy light (yên quang). The alchemist learns to make the haze itself medicine. A pill's vapour is breathed into the dantian before the pill is formed, Wood for the herb's life and Earth for the furnace clay. In a fight the cultivator breathes out that haze. Allies in it mend over time, and foes in it are slowed and gather Wood.

arts.concept: A cloud of medicinal haze for 6 s: allies inside gain a healing-over-time stack each second, and foes inside gain a Wood stack and are slowed.
Ends the haze early: every healing stack on allies resolves at once at 150 %, and the holder's next haze costs half.

techniques.lore: Diêm Tử Tô wrote it in 1070-1090, the years the pavilion's first pills sold to Lạc Hà. Tào Mộ Tử made Hình Lạc Nhạn's miasma tincture with it in 1195.

techniques.name: Gathered Haze Canon (Ngưng Yên Kinh)
techniques.concept: The founder's canon, named for her and for the line the pavilion takes its name from: the haze gathers, and the evening hills turn purple (yên quang ngưng nhi mộ sơn tử). It teaches the cultivator to hold the haze inside the body for a whole night and let it settle into the meridians, so that every pill taken heals more and every wound closes slowly from within. In a fight it gathers healing that has not yet been spent and holds it, then releases it as a single wave.

arts.concept: For 10 s, healing over time on the holder and nearby allies is stored instead of applied; at the end it is released at 160 % as one heal.

techniques.lore: Vi Ngưng Yên died in her breakthrough of 1150 holding a pill made under this canon. Diêm Tử Tô has taught it to no one since.
